design_summary: Synthesizable FPGA top module for firmware-mediated active-aerodynamics control over a 32-bit Wishbone CSR/MMIO interface, with bounded actuator outputs, compact status input sampling, command freshness supervision, stale rejection, timeout fallback, clamping, and sticky interrupt status handling. No geometry, tensor, or flow-field payloads are exposed at the top level.

fixed_assumptions: Wishbone is a single-master, single-slave style register interface at the top level.
All control-plane semantics are firmware-mediated through the CSR/MMIO registers.
All sequential logic is clocked by clk_i.
The top-level interface remains compact and well below 256 scalar-equivalent I/O.
The design is FPGA-oriented and should infer standard registers and comparators only.

top_module.name: adaptive_aero_control_top
top_module.description: Required synthesizable top-level wrapper implementing the application contract for intelligent active-aerodynamics supervision and actuation. It exposes the firmware-visible 32-bit Wishbone CSR/MMIO interface with address, write-data, read-data, byte enables, transaction valid, write enable, acknowledge, and optional error response semantics, plus compact actuator output, compact status input sampling, and interrupt output. It performs register decode, command acceptance, clamping, stale/timeout supervision, fallback behavior, and sticky interrupt generation.
top_module.functionality: Implements the complete externally observable device behavior for the adaptive aerodynamics controller. The top accepts firmware-issued register transactions, decodes all declared registers at word granularity, stores configuration and command values, validates sequence freshness, clamps actuator commands between configured limits, supervises age/timeouts, asserts fallback to safe state when control is disabled or commands become stale, latches faults, and produces sticky interrupt status. The top does not expose any bulk payload or high-dimensional model transport at the pin level, and it does not instantiate or claim any board-ready CPU subsystem at the top interface.
responsibilities: Provide a real firmware-visible Wishbone slave CSR/MMIO interface with adr_i, dat_i, dat_o, sel_i, cyc_i, stb_i, we_i, ack_o, and err_o semantics.
Decode and implement the mandated register map at 32-bit word granularity.
Support write enable semantics through we_i and acknowledge each accepted transaction with a single-cycle ack_o pulse.
Preserve bounded actuator output behavior using clamping and fallback selection.
Track command sequence freshness and command age, rejecting stale commands and recording the associated fault/status bits.
Maintain deterministic reset behavior and safe fallback output behavior.
Generate irq_o from sticky event status and IRQ enable state.
Keep all state suitable for straightforward FPGA synthesis at the specified 50 MHz clock.
Avoid exposing geometry, tensor, flow-field, or surrogate streaming payloads at the top level.
top_module.reset_behavior: On rst_ni deassertion, the module synchronously returns to a safe state: actuator_cmd_o is loaded from SAFE_STATE0, active is deasserted, fallback_active is asserted, command-age and sequence tracking are cleared, FAULT_CODE and IRQ_STATUS are cleared, ack_o and err_o are deasserted, and irq_o is deasserted. Control remains in fallback until CTRL.enable is set and a valid newer command is accepted.
behavior_rules: Wishbone ack_o shall assert for one clock cycle on accepted reads and writes.
we_i shall be used as the write-enable qualifier for CSR updates; reads occur when cyc_i and stb_i are asserted with we_i low.
Invalid or unmapped addresses may return zero on dat_o and may assert err_o when implemented, but shall not create multi-cycle bus dependencies.
CTRL bit0 enables control, bit1 clears latched faults, bit2 arms fallback override policy if implemented, and bit3 enables interrupt generation.
STATUS shall report active, fallback_active, stale_reject, timeout_fault, clamp_event, cmd_valid, and a fault-summary field derived from registered internal state.
CMD_SEQ stores the last written command sequence number and participates in strict newer-than acceptance checks.
CMD_AGE_MAX bounds the command age in cycles or control ticks before stale rejection occurs.
ACT_MIN0 and ACT_MAX0 define independent clamp bounds for the actuator command word fields, and clamped values are the only values driven to actuator_cmd_o.
SAFE_STATE0 is the deterministic fallback actuator word and is the reset-defined safe output source.
VEH_SPEED captures a compact fixed-point vehicle-speed/status sample from status_i.
FAULT_CODE is latched until cleared by the clear_fault mechanism or its defined write semantics.
IRQ_STATUS implements sticky write-1-to-clear bits for timeout, stale, clamp, and accepted-command events.
VERSION is read-only and provides module version and compatibility fields.
The design shall not invent a streaming model transport at the top level; command acceptance is firmware-mediated through the CSR/MMIO interface.
All outputs shall be registered or derived from registered state suitable for straightforward FPGA synthesis at 50 MHz.

top_level_connections.description: Top synchronous clock input is consumed by the controller logic.
Top active-low reset input initializes the controller and register state.
Wishbone address input for CSR/MMIO decode.
Wishbone write-data input for register programming.
Wishbone byte-select input for partial register writes.
Compact vehicle/status sample input consumed by the top-level controller.
Wishbone read-data output from the controller register file.
Wishbone acknowledge output pulse for accepted transactions.
Wishbone error output for invalid or unsupported accesses when implemented.
Registered compact actuator command output driven only by bounded, accepted values.
Interrupt output indicating accepted-command and safety-event conditions per enabled IRQ policy.

registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Control register for enable, fault clearing, fallback policy, and IRQ gating.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Live status summary including active/fallback/fault indicators.

registers.name: CMD_SEQ
registers.description: Sequence number for command freshness tracking and strict monotonic acceptance.

registers.name: CMD_AGE_MAX
registers.description: Maximum acceptable command age in control cycles or ticks before stale rejection.

registers.name: ACT_MIN0
registers.description: Packed minimum limit for the primary actuator command word.

registers.name: ACT_MAX0
registers.description: Packed maximum limit for the primary actuator command word.

registers.name: SAFE_STATE0
registers.description: Deterministic safe fallback actuator command word used on reset and fallback.

registers.name: VEH_SPEED
registers.description: Compact vehicle-speed/status input sample in fixed-point format.

registers.name: FAULT_CODE
registers.description: Latched fault code; clear-fault semantics clear this register and associated fault latches.

registers.name: IRQ_STATUS
registers.description: Sticky event bits for timeout, stale, clamp, and accepted-command interrupts.
